bias.invalidation_rule: every bias prints its invalidation; no invalidation, no bias printed (contract 4)
bias.method: count-based, equal weights, never fitted (D9 discipline)
bias.volatility_rule: A1.6(a): volatility casts NO vote; a compression flag demotes the final verdict one band toward Neutral-mixed

crowding.daily: funding percentile >= 90 votes -1; <= 10 votes +1; else 0 (A1.6b: symmetric)

location.daily: price vs anchored M-VWAP AND prior-day value area (+1 above both, -1 below both, else 0)
location.weekly: price vs anchored Q-VWAP AND 20d value area (+1 above both, -1 below both, else 0)

momentum.daily: 4h and 12h RSI agree on side AND slope sign (+1 bull, -1 bear, else 0)
momentum.weekly: 12h and 1d RSI agree on side AND slope sign

trend.daily: sign of the sum of governor regime dirs over lenses {1h, 4h}
trend.weekly: sign of the sum of governor regime dirs over lenses {4h, 12h}

rules.confluence_note: changes require a contract amendment and a rules_version bump (A1.4)
firewall: 1. live data: operations only, forbidden as study evidence
2. no journal reads; no signal-outcome or trade-outcome statistics on any window
3. engine modules imported read-only; signals/trading/cells unmodified; trading layer never invoked
4. hypothesis-mine clause: the archive may seed hypotheses but is never a scoring window; radar-outcome scoring prohibited
rules.naked_poc_scope: completed days only -- the current day's POC has no later bars to be tested against
rules.poi_grouping: one row per asset per rule; the leading instance is the most significant (nearest naked POC, highest divergence TF) and further instances survive as numbers.occurrences

poi_rules.POI-2: RSI divergence (regular or hidden) on 4h or above
poi_rules.POI-3: naked POC within 1.0 daily-ATR of price
poi_rules.POI-4: price crossed an anchored VWAP (M/Q/Y) within the last 24h
poi_rules.POI-6: session extension >1.5x the 20d median session range
poi_rules.POI-8: radar state changed vs the previous index line

provenance_legend.stale: input older than its native interval, or a degraded fetch

radar.arming: Z1 armed with every live campaign; Z2 likewise when prov_zones=Z1+Z2 (provisional included); Z3 only when stage-aligned (stage 2)
radar.doctrine_chip: playbook 5.5: "half size, Z1/Z2 only, grade <= B"
radar.no_sizing: no sizing field exists anywhere in this artifact (F-B7)
radar.post_x_rule: operator ruling 2026-07-27: an X's authority ends at the NEXT arming. POST_X holds only while no campaign has armed since the X (campaign_id proves it); a campaign armed after a recent X reports its true live state and carries post_x_caution=true instead. 'Never negotiate with an X' forbids re-entering the campaign that failed, not the one a fresh governor cross created.
radar.precedence: POST_X > DORMANT > DEFENSE > ENTERED > ZONE_ACTIVE > ARMED
radar.semantics: SSv11.0.2 playbook state machine; v11 semantics only (D2)
radar.zone_occupancy_rule: ZONE_ACTIVE means price is inside an armed band (two-sided containment). This is NOT the engine's tag memory, reported separately as engine_tag_zone; the radar never claims a tag.

rules.staleness_measured_from: the input bar's CLOSE time (open + interval), not its open; funding records are stamped at settlement and carry no bar interval
rules.staleness_rule: input older than one native interval prints a stale chip
